code: set.seed(1) toy_volc <- function(seed) {   set.seed(seed)   data.frame(     gene = paste0("G", 1:20),     contrast = "toy",     logFC = c(rnorm(10, 2), rnorm(10, -2)),     P.Value = c(runif(10, 0, 0.01), runif(10, 0, 0.01)),     padj = c(runif(10, 0, 0.04), runif(10, 0, 0.04))   ) } toy_enrich <- function(seed) {   set.seed(seed)   data.frame(     pathway = paste0("HALLMARK_TOY_", LETTERS[1:5]),     NES = c(2.4, 1.8, -1.5, -2.1, 0.4),     padj = c(0.001, 0.02, 0.01, 0.005, 0.5),     size = c(40, 30, 25, 35, 18),     leading_edge = c(       "G1;G2;G3;G4", "G5;G6", "G11;G12",       "G13;G14;G15;G16", "G7;G17"     )   ) } g <- suppressMessages(volcano_ring_grid(   list(A = toy_volc(1), B = toy_volc(2)),   list(A = toy_enrich(1), B = toy_enrich(2)),   ncol = 2 )) g$plot

title: Input contract
text: genes_col = NULL (default), volcano_ring() walks four conventional column names order: leading_edge (;-separated string) leadingEdge (list-column, fgsea native) core_enrichment (/-separated string, clusterProfiler GSEA) Genes (;-separated string, enrichR) First match wins. cli_alert_info() names column. match silently turns tick lines — rings still draw, just without radial tick segments inside volcano. Override genes_col = "my_column" , string column, matching genes_sep (defaults ";" column string).

title: Input contract
text: Three patterns work, increasing order intrusiveness: Argument-renames: volcano_ring(..., padj_col = "adj.P.Val"). frame mutation, good one-plots. Boundary rename: names(da)[names(da) == "adj.P.Val"] <- "padj". Useful several functions pipeline expect name. Built-column shim: write tiny adapter to_evolc(df) returns renamed frame. Worth project-specific upstream format reuse lot. DA enrichment sides disagree padj column name (e.g. adj.P.Val vs padj), one renamed boundary — padj_col single shared argument design.

title: enrichVolcano 0.3.0
text: enrichVolcano now plotting-package. Enrichment computation removed. Compute enrichment fgsea::fgseaMultilevel(), clusterProfiler::gseGO(), enrichR::enrichr(), tool like, pass resulting tidy table volcano_ring().

title: enrichVolcano 0.3.0
text: Enrichment engine: ev_enrich(), ev_collapse(), list_databases(), database_info(), load_go_slim(), apply_gate(). Scoring + adjustment: pi_score(), adjust_p(). Input layer: ev_read_contrasts(), ev_validate(), ev_idmap_report(). Hero wrapper: enrich_volcano(). Shiny app: ev_app() (relocated sibling enrichVolcanoApp repo).

title: enrichVolcano 0.3.0
text: ev_volcano_ring() -> volcano_ring() ev_compose() -> volcano_ring_grid() (signature changed; now takes paired lists tidy DA + enrichment frames keyed contrast, returns S3 volcano_ring_grid object carrying $plot $data). ev_theme() -> volcano_ring_theme() (new args: base_family, nes_limits, nes_stops; palettes: "default", "viridis", "okabe"). print.enrichVolcano() -> print.volcano_ring_grid(). ev_volcano() ring_plot() removed entirely — composite plot.

title: enrichVolcano 0.3.0
text: Column-naming arguments volcano_ring(): gene_col, logfc_col, pval_col, padj_col, term_col, nes_col, size_col, genes_col, genes_sep. Defaults assume limma + fgsea conventional names. Tick-line column auto-detect: leading_edge (;-string), leadingEdge (list-col), core_enrichment (/-string), Genes (;-string) work box. Override via genes_col. Structured error classes: enrichVolcano_input_error, enrichVolcano_column_error, enrichVolcano_data_error, enrichVolcano_param_error — parent enrichVolcano_error. magnitude = c("neg_log_padj", "size") controls arc-thickness encoding ring.

title: enrichVolcano 0.2.0
text: default fgsea ranking statistic (rank_by) now "t", limma / proteoDA moderated t-statistic, instead "signed_p". recommended signed GSEA statistic moderated linear models (Subramanian 2005 PNAS; Reimand 2019 Nat Protoc) matches hand-written source pipelines. Inputs without t column (e.g. edgeR) fall back "signed_p" automatically, limma-family results change. Pass rank_by = "signed_p" restore previous behaviour.

title: enrichVolcano 0.2.0
text: ev_enrich(nperm = ...) now actually takes effect — passed fgsea::fgseaMultilevel() nPermSimple (previously -op). ev_collapse(keep_by = "NES") now ranks representatives |NES|, strongly -regulated pathway longer dropped favour weakly -regulated one. ev_collapse() longer collapses - -regulated pathway share leading-edge genes — dedup now within-direction. adjust_p(method = "qvalue") falls back BH (warning) instead erroring contrast p-values estimate pi0. ev_validate() guards MaxQuant ratios <= 0 (set NA warning) instead producing -Inf/NaN log2 values. ev_read_contrasts() longer creates duplicate adj.P.Val column padj collides existing one. ev_compose() matches volcano/ring lists name (order-insensitive) rather requiring identical name order.

title: enrichVolcano 0.2.0
text: ev_collapse(scope = ...) accepts vector stages run order, e.g. c("within_db", "cross_db"): stage collapses survivors previous, redundancy can cleaned within database first merged across databases. cutoff may one value per stage. (Within/across database redundancy control follows Vivar 2013 ReCiPa, PMID 23758478.) ev_volcano_ring() enrich_volcano() gain nes_limits (default c(-3, 3)) widen NES colour scale enrichment exceeds |NES| = 3. ev_collapse() gains similarity argument selecting gene-overlap metric Jaccard-family steps: "jaccard" (default), "overlap" (, catches small set contained larger one), "combined" (Cytoscape EnrichmentMap coefficient ; Merico 2010, PMID 21085593), combined_weight (default 0.5). Forwarded enrich_volcano(dedup = ...). Default behaviour unchanged (similarity = "jaccard"). ev_collapse() default method now "collapse_then_jaccard", matching source pipeline generated YvO 2025 figures. previous default "jaccard" remains available; alias "" deprecated removed future release. ev_collapse() gains sig_threshold (default 0.05) non-significant pathways longer affected dedup. Pass NA restore previous dedup--rows behavior. ev_enrich() gains include_terms filter_mode = c("","display") pre-test post-hoc pathway-name filtering. See vignette("pathway-dedup") use . ev_enrich() output now carries ev_filter attribute recording filter inputs per-database pathway counts filtering.

title: enrichVolcano 0.2.0
text: enrich_volcano() longer pins method = "jaccard" dedup default; hero function now inherits whatever default ev_collapse() ships, users calling wrapper defaults get documented "collapse_then_jaccard" behavior. ev_collapse_fgsea() now looks pathway gene sets (database, pathway) rather name alone. previous flatten preserved duplicate pathway names across databases, user combining (example) custom GMT MSigDB collection shared pathway name get first database’s gene set rows. ev_collapse_fgsea() now partitions input contrast runs fgsea::collapsePathways per contrast matching gene-level rank vector. Previously, scope = "global" multiple contrasts, every pathway silently scored first contrast’s ranks. ev_collapse(method = "jaccard_then_collapse") (deprecated "" alias) now passes Jaccard survivors collapse step writes back positionally, mirroring "collapse_then_jaccard". previous -merge drop members redundant cluster collapsePathways Jaccard’s keep_by tie-breaker disagreed row represented cluster. ev_enrich() ev_filter$n_pathways_after now structurally parallel n_pathways_before even every contrast empty (previously integer(0) instead named integer keyed database).
